title: Lebanese-Style Tarator with Poached Garlic
description: Poaching the garlic first gives this lemon-tahini sauce a mellow flavor and a pourable, creamy texture without dairy.

ingredients.name: fresh garlic cloves
ingredients.note: Peel and finely grate unless the step specifies otherwise.

ingredients.name: table salt
ingredients.note: Fine table salt, about 590 mg sodium per 1/4 teaspoon. Low-sodium batch: use 1/16 tsp total.

steps.title: Poach the garlic
steps.text: Keep {ga} whole and simmer gently in {w}, covered, for 6–8 minutes until easily crushed. Reserve the poaching liquid.

steps.title: Mash the seasoning
steps.text: Mash the cloves with {cu} and {salt} until smooth.

steps.title: Tighten the tahini
steps.text: Whisk {tah} and {le} into the garlic paste. It will briefly become thick and pale.

steps.title: Whisk until pourable
steps.text: Add the warm poaching liquid a little at a time, whisking until the sauce turns glossy and leaves a ribbon off the whisk.

steps.title: Set the yield
steps.text: Transfer to a measuring cup. Adjust to 1 cup, adding sodium-free water a teaspoon at a time if short. The finished sauce should cling to a spoon.

steps.title: Serve the sauce
steps.text: Serve at room temperature over fish, chicken or soft roasted vegetables. Stir before spooning.

notes: Yield: 1 cup, or four 1/4-cup portions. Low-sodium option for the full batch: Use 1/16 tsp table salt in place of 1/4 tsp. Use the same final 1-cup yield and 1/4-cup serving. Make ahead: Make the sauce the day before and portion it before chilling. Refrigerate in shallow covered portions within 2 hours and use within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze for up to 1 month. The tahini may split slightly but blends smooth after thawing. Fridge reheat: Serve chilled. Stir well straight from the refrigerator. Freezer reheat: If frozen, thaw overnight in the refrigerator and whisk or blend until smooth. Serve cold. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For a gentler Option B, use only 1 teaspoon lemon juice and a single poached garlic clove. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 115 kcal, 3.3 g protein, 4.8 g total carbohydrate, 10.1 g fat, 1.8 g fiber, 169 mg sodium. Low-sodium version per 1/4 cup: 115 kcal, 3.3 g protein, 4.8 g total carbohydrate, 10.1 g fat, 1.8 g fiber, 59 mg sodium. Figures cover the sauce alone. Sodium varies with brands.
